name: @limette/core
description: A full-stack framework for Lit Web Components.

scripts.check: deno check src/mod.ts src/vite/mod.ts src/deno.ts src/node.ts
scripts.check:examples: deno check --config examples/deno.json examples/app.js examples/main.js examples/vite.config.ts
scripts.check:smoke: deno check --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/island-discovery.ts tests/smoke/vite-build.ts tests/smoke/vite-server.ts tests/smoke/vite-assets.ts tests/smoke/vite-ssr.ts tests/smoke/vite-dev-routes.ts tests/smoke/vite-dev-server.ts tests/smoke/node-server.ts tests/smoke/_vite-command.ts
scripts.test:smoke: deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/island-discovery.ts && npm run test:smoke:routes && deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/vite-build.ts && deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/vite-server.ts && deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/vite-assets.ts && deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/vite-ssr.ts
scripts.test:smoke:server: deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/node-server.ts && deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/vite-dev-routes.ts && deno run -A --config examples/deno.json tests/smoke/vite-dev-server.ts
